dialogues.speaker: Huachu
dialogues.text: Oh yes, sorry... I am the second daughter of the manager of the Minghua Company. Today, exceptionally, I have taken an excursion.

dialogues.speaker: Huachu
dialogues.text: But with this being my first excursion ever, I am struggling to adapt.

response.speaker: Huachu
response.text: Yes... Out of consideration for the business, I limited myself to a single travel partner.

response.speaker: Huachu
response.text: Apologies, that information is company confidential.
